selection_reasoning: These four tasks form a coherent multi-hop chain centered around white/flower-themed items and wool products. The player must first find azure_bluet and white_tulip (flowers that can be crafted into white dye), then craft white_carpet (which requires white wool, obtainable from white dye + wool or directly), and finally sell Black Wool to a merchant (representing a trade/commerce task that requires the player to have navigated the scene and interacted with villagers). The dependency structure: finding flowers feeds into crafting (as dye sources or scene navigation prerequisites), and crafting white_carpet demonstrates material processing before the final selling task which requires locating a merchant. The flowers serve as navigation/exploration tasks that orient the player in the scene before more complex interactions.

White tulip provides white dye needed to create white wool for crafting white carpet
Crafting white carpet familiarizes player with wool resources; black wool for selling is near the same supply area

Target is the closer azure_bluet at spawn-relative (3, 0, 4). Max distance of 5 blocks with 60° facing tolerance ensures the player is looking at the flower.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the white_tulip flower and face it to demonstrate they have visually located it. Target is the white_tulip at spawn-relative (-4, 0, 3). Max distance of 5 blocks with 60° facing tolerance ensures the player is looking at the flower.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted white_carpet ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with 4 white_wool and 0 white_carpet, so having ≥1 white_carpet can only result from crafting (2 white wool → 3 white carpet). This is the standard rule for craft tasks.

Uses inventory_has to check for emerald because selling black wool to the shepherd villager yields an emerald. The player starts with 0 emeralds and the only source of emeralds in this scene is the villager trade (2 black wool → 1 emerald). Having ≥1 emerald confirms the trade was completed successfully.

scene_description: A flat 21x21 grass meadow with two small oak plank huts and scattered flowers. The SE hut contains a crafting table for wool crafting. The W hut houses a stationary shepherd villager for trading. Azure bluets and white tulips are placed across the meadow as exploration targets. The player starts with white wool (4), shears (1), and black wool (3) in their inventory.
task_text: Explore the meadow to find an azure bluet and a white tulip flower. Then craft white carpet from your white wool. Finally, sell your black wool to the shepherd villager.
design_notes: Layout: Player spawns at center (0,0,0) of 21x21 grass platform. Crafting hut at SE corner (~6-9, ~0, ~6-9) with crafting table at (~7,~0,~6) and doorway at (~6,~1-2,~7). Villager hut at W side (~-8 to ~-5, ~0, ~-1 to ~1) with shepherd villager at (~-6,~0,~0) and doorway at (~-5,~1-2,~0). Azure bluets at (~3,~0,~4) and (~5,~0,~-3). White tulips at (~-4,~0,~3) and (~-3,~0,~-5). Player has 4 white wool (needs 2 for carpet), shears, and 3 black wool (needs 2 for trade, 1 spare). Villager accepts 2 black wool for 1 emerald. NoAI keeps villager stationary.
